entry.title: Jonufer Beach
entry.summary: Jonufer is a quiet stretch of coast just north of Vlora, where the Adriatic meets the Ionian Sea. The beach is a mix of sand and pebbles with clear water, and a few cafes serve fresh fish.

entry.title: Saranda Beach
entry.summary: Saranda is a lively port town on the Ionian coast, and its waterfront pebble beach looks across the strait to Corfu. The water is clear, and the promenade is lined with cafes and restaurants.

entry.title: Umag Beach
entry.summary: Umag sits on a small peninsula on the north-west coast of Istria, and its beaches are a mix of pebbles, rocks and concrete platforms. The sea is clean and calm, and the old town is a short walk away.

entry.title: Crikvenica Beach
entry.summary: Crikvenica has several kilometres of pebble and shingle beach along its seafront promenade on the Kvarner coast. The water is clear and shallow, with sections of sand and concrete platforms for sunbathing.

entry.title: Grande Plage de Quiberon
entry.summary: The Grande Plage of Quiberon is a sheltered curve of sand facing the bay, with calm water and a seafront lined with cafes. It is on the Quiberon peninsula, which is known for its wild coast on the other side.

entry.title: Plage de Deauville
entry.summary: The beach of Deauville is a broad stretch of fine sand with a famous wooden boardwalk, Les Planches, and rows of colourful parasols. The tide is large, and the water is cool even in summer.

entry.title: Plage de la Grande Conche
entry.summary: The Grande Conche is the main beach of Royan, a wide curve of fine sand backed by a promenade and 1950s architecture. The water is shallow, with a long tidal range and a steady Atlantic breeze.

entry.title: Praia de Quarteira
entry.summary: Quarteira has a very long beach of golden sand and a wide promenade, with a fishing quarter at the western end. The sea is calm and the slope is gentle, which suits families and long walks.

entry.title: Spiaggia di Termoli
entry.summary: Termoli has a long sandy beach on the Adriatic coast, just below its medieval old town and castle. The water is shallow, warm and clear, and it is much quieter than the beaches of Romagna.

entry.title: Spiaggia di Alassio
entry.summary: Alassio has a long beach of golden sand, one of the widest on the Ligurian coast, below a promenade of cafes and shops. The water is clear and calm, with the hills of the Riviera delle Palme behind.

entry.title: Spiaggia di Riccione
entry.summary: Riccione has a wide, gently shelving beach of fine sand, organised into numbered bathing clubs along a busy promenade. The water is warm and shallow, and the resort is known for its nightlife.

entry.title: Perissa Beach
entry.summary: Perissa is a long beach of black volcanic sand and fine pebbles on the southeast coast of Santorini, beneath the rocky ridge of Mesa Vouno. The sea is deep blue, and the black stones get very hot by midday.

entry.title: Faliraki Beach
entry.summary: Faliraki is a long sandy beach on the east coast of Rhodes, with shallow clear water and a wide range of water sports. The strip is lively, with hotels, bars and sunbeds along most of its length.

entry.title: Plage de Cavalaire
entry.summary: The main beach of Cavalaire-sur-Mer is a long arc of fine sand with a gentle slope into the water. It is backed by a seafront promenade and sits at the foot of the Maures hills.

entry.title: Mogren Beach
entry.summary: Mogren is a pair of small coves just beside the old town of Budva, joined by a footpath cut into the cliffs. The beaches are made of fine pebbles and coarse sand, and the water is clear.

entry.title: Praia de Armacao de Pera
entry.summary: Armacao de Pera has one of the longest sandy beaches in the Algarve, stretching for several kilometres below a small resort town. The sand is soft and the water is shallow, so it suits families.

entry.title: Playa de Poniente
entry.summary: Poniente is the calmer of the two big city beaches of Benidorm, with fine golden sand and a long promenade. It is backed by the high rise skyline and has shallow, clear water.

entry.title: Playa de la Carihuela
entry.summary: La Carihuela is a long flat beach of dark sand in Torremolinos, backed by a promenade and the former fishermen quarter. The area is known for its fish restaurants and beach bars called chiringuitos.

entry.title: Spiaggia della Purita
entry.summary: Spiaggia della Purita is a small sandy beach just outside the old town of Gallipoli on the Ionian coast. The water is clear and shallow, and the white town walls rise right behind the sand.

entry.title: Pizzomunno Beach
entry.summary: The beach of Pizzomunno is a curve of pale sand in Vieste, dominated by a white limestone stack that gives it its name. The water is shallow and clear, and the old town of Vieste is a short walk away.

entry.title: Jesolo Beach
entry.summary: Jesolo has about fifteen kilometres of fine sand on the Adriatic coast, a short drive from Venice. The sea is shallow and warm, and the beach is lined with bathing clubs, hotels and a long promenade.

entry.title: Plage des Catalans
entry.summary: Plage des Catalans is the closest sandy beach to the Old Port of Marseille, below the Pharo gardens. It is lively and urban, with shallow sheltered water and views toward the Frioul islands.

entry.title: Plage de la Garoupe
entry.summary: Plage de la Garoupe is a sheltered crescent of sand on the cape of Antibes, with calm clear water and a green backdrop of pines. It is a favourite Riviera beach with private clubs and a public section.

entry.title: Trstenica Beach
entry.summary: Trstenica is a long beach of fine shingle and sand beside the town of Orebic on the Peljesac peninsula. The water is shallow and clear, with views across the channel to the island of Korcula.

entry.title: Lapad Beach
entry.summary: Lapad Beach lies in a sheltered bay on the Lapad peninsula, a short bus ride from the old town of Dubrovnik. The shore mixes fine pebbles with concrete platforms, and the water is clear and calm.

entry.title: Dinard Beach
entry.summary: The main beach of Dinard is a long sandy bay below Belle Epoque villas on the Emerald Coast of Brittany. The tide range is large, and the beach has striped cabins, lifeguards in season and a seafront promenade.

entry.title: Plage de la Salis
entry.summary: A sheltered sandy beach at Antibes with calm, shallow water that suits families, and views across the bay. Public sections sit alongside private beach restaurants.

entry.title: Plage de la Croisette
entry.summary: The sandy beaches along the famous Boulevard de la Croisette in Cannes, a mix of private beach clubs and free public sections. The water is calm and shallow, and the promenade is ideal for a stroll with views of the bay.

entry.title: Podgora Beach
entry.summary: A long pebble beach in Podgora on the Makarska Riviera, backed by pines with views across to the island of Brac. It is quieter than Makarska and Brela, and the water is clear.

entry.title: Medulin Beach
entry.summary: A broad bay at the southern tip of Istria with shallow water, pebble and stone beaches and pine shade. It is a family favourite, and several beaches along the coast have showers and lifeguards in season.
